mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, employee_id AS employeeId, department_id AS departmentId, status FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password_hash, employee_id, department_id, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{status})
